metadata.title: sbourdeaud
metadata.description: This module provides miscellaneous functions used in Nutanix services scripts.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Send-FileToPrism' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
